cohort: 303 neonates admitted to Mettu Karl Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (MKCSH) and Darimu Primary Hospital (DPH) in Ilu Abba Bor Zone, South West Ethiopia, from November 1 to December 28, 2020
finding: No formal maternal education, breech presentation, <4 ANC visits, cesarean section delivery, APH, and HDP were independently associated with NNM.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was independently associated with increased odds of NNM.
